Frequently asked questions

Source: vignettes/articles/learn/faq.Rmd
faq.Rmd

Can I use surveyframe for my thesis?

Yes. Start from one of the questionnaire templates, replace its questions with yours, and submit the pre-analysis plan to your supervisor or ethics committee before you collect data. The report follows APA 7.

Can I run the whole study in SurveyStudio?

Yes. After install.packages("surveyframe"), everything runs in SurveyStudio, opened from RStudio’s Addins menu. See Get started.

How do I preregister my analysis plan on OSF?

Write the pre-analysis plan from SurveyStudio, or with render_report() and no data, and upload it to OSF or Zenodo with the .sframe file. The plan names the file’s hash, so the registration identifies the exact instrument.

How are answers collected?

Export the questionnaire from SurveyStudio’s Collect screen as 1 HTML file, and choose how to host it, such as on your institution’s web space. To collect responses in a Google Sheet you own, configure the Apps Script collector, as the Collect screen’s steps show.

How does a reader check which questionnaire was used?

Open the .sframe file at surveyframe.org/verify. The page checks whether the file matches the hash recorded when it was saved, and shows its recorded amendments. To identify a registered version, compare the hash with the one in the independently preserved registration, such as on OSF.

Are the demo data real?

No. The demos’ responses are simulated. Each respondent id starts with DEMO-, and every result and report made from them says “demonstration data”.

How do I cite surveyframe?

See Cite surveyframe.
